abilities.goal: Classify only unmasked executable verification commands as Pico verification receipts.

learning.result: Unwrapped an optional 'uv run' prefix, then accepted only pytest, mypy, tox, nox, selected ruff actions, selected make targets, package-manager test/build commands, cargo build/check/test, go build/test/vet, and common JVM build tools.
Rejected commands containing shell control operators including &&, ||, semicolon, pipe, ampersand, carriage return, or newline so a failing check cannot be masked.
Did not treat prose such as 'tests passed' or unrelated commands as verification evidence; command outcome remains a separate observed receipt.

held_out.prompt: Implement Pico's verification_name classifier for direct and uv-wrapped Python checks.
Implement Pico's verification_name classifier so compound shell commands cannot masquerade as successful checks.
Implement Pico's verification_name classifier for supported package and compiled-language build commands.
Implement Pico's verification_name classifier without inventing evidence from unrelated commands or prose.

hard_negatives.query: Build a shell pipeline that archives pytest logs.
Explain how GitHub Actions displays test badges.
Write release notes saying all checks passed.
Compare package-manager lockfile formats.

abilities.goal: Apply Pico's fail-closed admission policy to Memory-derived Skill candidates.

learning.result: Marked Memory-derived candidates as gate-required; Provider, timeout, and parse failures abstained from those candidates while preserving legacy Local candidates.
Accepted only exact candidate IDs. An unknown ID invalidated a gate-required decision instead of silently injecting the known subset.
Treated an explicit empty selection as a valid rejection and limited successful admission to the configured maximum.
learning.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_skill_forge_gate.py -k 'empty_skills or max_select'

held_out.prompt: Implement select_skills so a failed Gate preserves Local candidates but cannot inject learned Memory candidates.
Implement select_skills with Pico's exact-ID policy for an unknown Gate selection.
Implement select_skills so an explicit empty Gate decision injects nothing.
Implement select_skills with exact ordering and Pico's two-Skill admission limit.

hard_negatives.query: Rank local documentation files for a search page.
Design an HTTP gateway admission controller.
Select two songs for a short playlist.
Explain memory allocation in CPython.

abilities.goal: Resolve Pico's shadow-checkpoint policy from configuration and invocation mode.

learning.result: Policy 'never' disables checkpoints for every invocation mode.
Policy 'always' enables checkpoints even for non-interactive one-shot runs.
Default policy 'interactive' follows the caller's interactive signal: TUI, REPL, and gateway runs enable it; one-shot message runs do not.

held_out.prompt: Implement checkpoint_active for Pico's never policy across interactive and one-shot calls.
Implement checkpoint_active for Pico's always policy across invocation modes.
Implement checkpoint_active for Pico's default interactive policy.
Implement checkpoint_active with explicit validation of Pico's supported policy values.

hard_negatives.query: Create a database checkpoint during compaction.
Explain interactive rebasing in Git.
Save a video-game checkpoint every minute.
Compare one-shot and few-shot prompting.

abilities.goal: Isolate a failing Skill source while preserving successful source results and diagnostics.

learning.result: Converted one source exception into an empty contribution and preserved hits returned by other sources.
Recorded failed source names in source order and mapped each name to its exception type.
Returned an empty result rather than raising when every source failed; failure diagnostics remained available.

held_out.prompt: Implement isolate_sources so a Memory failure does not remove successful Local Skill hits.
Implement isolate_sources with ordered failure names and stable failure-type diagnostics.
Implement isolate_sources when all configured Skill sources fail.
Implement isolate_sources without changing successful source or hit ordering.

abilities.goal: Classify PicoBench delivery independently from Runner completion.

learning.result: Classified an emitted response through the matching outlet as delivered.
Classified outlet rejection, Provider failure, and a completed-but-silent Turn as dropped rather than successful delivery.
learning.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_picobench_trial_host.py -k 'dropped or missing_delivery'

learning.result: Classified an event with no matching outlet as no_outlet, distinct from a matching outlet that dropped it.

held_out.prompt: Implement delivery_outcome for a completed Pico Turn whose response reached the matching outlet.
Implement delivery_outcome for matching outlets that reject output or receive a silent Turn.
Implement delivery_outcome when no outlet matches the Turn's channel.
Implement delivery_outcome so Runner state and user-visible delivery remain separate facts.

abilities.goal: Keep an Evolver candidate pending until its gates and human activation authority are satisfied.

learning.result: A promoted candidate begins in pending_human and does not move HEAD, edit the live checkout, deploy, or auto-activate.
Only runtime candidates may pass the production activation gate; prompt, policy, route, Skill, and model-profile candidates remain unsupported for automatic activation.
A candidate without credited sealed evidence cannot become activation-ready even when train-side promotion succeeded.

held_out.prompt: Implement activation_state for a promoted runtime candidate awaiting human authority.
Implement activation_state for non-runtime candidate kinds at Pico's production gate.
Implement activation_state when sealed evidence is not credited.
Implement activation_state for the exact runtime candidate that passed evidence gates and received human approval.
